parameters.name: X-Glean-Include-Experimental
parameters.description: This endpoint is experimental, so requests must include this header set to `true`. See [How experimental APIs work](https://developers.glean.com/experimental/overview) for details.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of users to return. Defaults to 50. Maximum is 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Send the same filters that the previous request used.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON-encoded filters that choose which users are returned. The supported fields are is_active, name, email, manager_id, and department_id, each with the operator EQUALS. Multiple values OR within a filter. Multiple filters AND together. Only is_active may appear in more than one filter. Without an is_active filter, only active users are returned, so a filter on another field matches only active users unless an is_active filter includes "false". To return active and inactive users, send [{"field":"is_active","values":["true","false"]}]. A value that matches no user, such as an unknown email or department_id, returns no users rather than an error.

schema.description: Filters on user fields, combined with AND.

items.description: One filter on a user field.

field.description:
The user field to filter on.
- is_active: "true" matches active users and "false" matches inactive
  users.

- name: matches users whose display_name contains the value, ignoring
  case and surrounding whitespace. Each value is at most 256 characters.

- email: matches the user with the email, ignoring case. An alias email
  matches only when the list would return it in alias_emails.

- manager_id: matches the direct reports of the user with this user_id. An
  alias ID of a merged person matches the same reports.

- department_id: matches users in the department, as returned in
  department.department_id.

values.description: The values to match. A user matches when any value matches.

items.description: A value to match. Blank values are rejected.

operator.description: The only supported operator is EQUALS. Defaults to EQUALS.

items.title: PlatformUserFilter

email.summary: The user with a primary or alias email

managerId.summary: The direct reports of a manager

departmentId.summary: Active and inactive users in a department

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Optional fields to add to each user. Each value only adds fields; it does not change which users are returned.

items.description: An optional field group to add to each user.
